text:
hana: Heads-up, Meridian's security team sent back the vendor risk form asking: 1) Do you keep embeddings beyond 90 days for Hosted? 2) How to request deletion? 3) Will deletion break any ongoing search or analytics pipelines? They want a short paragraph we can paste. :clipboard:

 diego: Quick facts: Hosted default retention is 90 days; we may keep short-lived cache copies for up to 120 hours for performance, but the canonical stored vectors follow contract. Deletion requests accepted via support or API.

 tara: For the form keep super concise. Suggested text: "Embedding vectors derived from your data are retained per your agreement (Hosted default: 90 days). You may request deletion via our support portal or our Data Deletion API; deletion workflows are asynchronous and typically complete within 72 hours. Deletion removes stored vectors and index entries but does not alter model weights or previously exported artifacts."

 hana: good. meridian also asked whether deletion can be scoped (e.g., delete embedding sets created between two dates). can we include an example?

 diego: Yes. API supports filters. Example curl: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/MERID/requests/deletions 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" 
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
 -d '{"type":"embeddings","before":"2024-06-01","after":"2024-01-01","reason":"customer_request"}'
``` Response includes deletion_job_id; attach that ID for audit.

 legal-bot: Reminder: do not promise immediate purging of backups. Use phrase "may require additional time for backups and audit processes". Also include contact point for escalation to Legal if they request signed attestation.

 tara: I'll shorten the legal bit for the form: "Note: backups and audit retention may require extra time to fully remove data; signed attestations available on request."

 hana: perfect. i'll paste the 2-sentence answer into the vendor form with the curl snippet in the contact appendix. cs-bot please create follow-up to provide deletion-job evidence if they ask. :white_check_mark:

 cs-bot: Created task: /task create "Meridian - vendor form reply + evidence template" due:+1d assignee:@hana

 hana: thanks all — sending now. if they ask for an attestation i'll ping legal.
